Four Perspectives, One Synthesis

The Silicon Architect

Hardware & Infrastructure Visionary

The Training Architect

Deep Learning & Software Visionary

Zooms into the training and reasoning layer — the algorithms, the architecture choices, the emergent behaviors. Software 2.0 from the inside, questioned from first principles.

The Agentic Architect

Multi-Agent Systems Visionary

The Material Architect

Industrial Realist & Visionary Value

focus: energy, supply chains, scale, economic value
